name: my-task-please-add-a-feature-to-the-parser
prompt: Implement exactly this and nothing else: please add a feature to the parser. Work in the checked-out tree, run the tests, leave them passing.

agent._comment_env: Keys must be in the server's FOREMAN_JOBSITES_AGENT_ENV_ALLOWLIST; values are never persisted on JobsiteStarted, so a RESUMED jobsite runs without them. On the docker sandbox this env-file is the agent's ONLY credential channel (the container cannot read the host ~/.claude or ~/.pi auth, so a spec with no env fails 'Not logged in'). A host sandbox inherits the server BEAM's environment instead.
